assumptions: The variable `slp` is modeled as an externally supplied slip-error or PID-supervisor signal used by the discrete FSM guards; the continuous wheel-speed, vehicle-speed, slip-ratio, and PID computations remain outside this discrete pyfcstm model as described in the NL.
The initial state is `increase` because the NL lists the states in the order `increase`, `hold`, `decrease` and no separate initial state is specified.

grounding_seeds.evidence_text: single-wheel ABS hydraulic regulator as a three-state FSM
The FSM contains the states `increase`, `hold`, and `decrease`
The FSM contains the states `increase`, `hold`, and `decrease`
The FSM contains the states `increase`, `hold`, and `decrease`
transition guards split the slip-error space into four bands: `increase -> hold` when `slp <= 0.01`
increase sets `k1=1, k2=0, n=0`; hold neutralizes both valves with `k1=0`; decrease sets `k1=0`
increase sets `k1=1, k2=0, n=0`; hold neutralizes both valves with `k2=0`; decrease sets `k2=1`
increase sets `n=0`; hold neutralizes both valves with `n=0`; decrease sets `n=500` to release pressure

M1_guard_off_by_one.description: guard `>= N` mistakenly written as `>= N-1` (fires one cycle too early)

M2_wrong_transition_target.description: transition `A -> B` written as `A -> C` (wrong target state)

M3_unreachable_target.description: guard threshold set far too high (`>= 99999`), target state never reached

M4_missing_forced_transition.description: forced transition `! ...` line missing (global event ignored)

M6_wrong_effect_value.description: effect assigns wrong constant (`var = N` → `var = N+100`)

scenario_results.description: default-init: first cycle dispatches to increase with inlet command, then slp=0.01 satisfies increase->hold and neutralizes valves.
scenario_results.name: default_init_increase_then_hold_at_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: increase must not transition to hold when slp is just above the slp<=0.01 guard boundary.
scenario_results.name: increase_no_hold_above_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: hold transitions to increase when slp is just above 0.01 and commands inlet-valve increase behavior.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_increase_above_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: hold must not take the strict slp>0.01 transition at exactly slp=0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_no_increase_at_upper_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: hold transitions to decrease when slp is just below -0.01 and commands pressure release.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_decrease_below_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: hold must not take the strict slp<-0.01 transition at exactly slp=-0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_no_decrease_at_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: decrease transitions back to hold at exactly slp=-0.01 under the inclusive slp>=-0.01 guard.
scenario_results.name: decrease_to_hold_at_lower_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start: decrease must stay in pressure-release mode when slp is still below -0.01.
scenario_results.name: decrease_no_hold_below_lower_boundary

evidence: NL states: increase sets k1=1,k2=0,n=0; hold sets k1=0,k2=0,n=0; decrease sets k1=0,k2=1,n=500.
DSL states increase/hold/decrease assign those same constants in enter and during actions.
NL guards: increase->hold slp<=0.01, hold->increase slp>0.01, hold->decrease slp<-0.01, decrease->hold slp>=-0.01.
DSL contains the same four guarded transitions.
findings.summary: The DSL faithfully implements the three named ABS hydraulic regulator states, their valve/pump output assignments, and the four specified slip-error threshold transitions.

evidence: GroundingMap marks ABSHydraulicRegulator, increase, hold, decrease, slp, k1, k2, n, all three output actions, and all four transition guards as required.
inspect_model_to_json_summary reports n_states_leaf=3, n_states_composite=1, n_transitions_normal=5, n_variables=4, action_count=6.
findings.summary: Required discrete supervisor components are covered: one composite regulator, three leaf states, four guard transitions plus the initial transition, and variables slp, k1, k2, and n.

evidence: NL says wheel speed and vehicle speed are used to compute slip ratio and PID output drives the Stateflow supervisor.
NL also says the continuous wheel-slip dynamics remain in the plant model.
GroundingMap assumption states slp is externally supplied and continuous wheel-speed, vehicle-speed, slip-ratio, and PID computations remain outside this discrete pyfcstm model.
findings.summary: The continuous wheel-speed/vehicle-speed slip computation and PID controller are not modeled, but the NL explicitly allows these to remain outside the discrete supervisor; this is a scoped abstraction rather than a blocking omission.

evidence: design_diagnostics_summary includes W_UNWRITTEN_READ_VAR for slp and W_GUARD_VARS_NEVER_CHANGE instances.
design_diagnostics_summary inspect_summary lists nl_external_input_vars: ["slp"].
external_input_role_ledger identifies slp as an external_input_candidate.
findings.summary: The DSL declares slp as a normal float initialized to 0.0 even though it is semantically an external input/PID-supervisor signal. This causes guard-variable-never-change and unwritten-read diagnostics, but the role ledger mitigates the concern.

evidence: Current DSL models the concrete three-state FSM and threshold map described in the NL.
The omitted continuous computations are explicitly described as outside the discrete pyfcstm model in the GroundingMap assumptions.
findings.summary: No blocking over-simplification is observed for the stated discrete-supervisor scope. The abstraction collapses the PID and plant into external slp, but preserves all required supervisor states, thresholds, and output commands.

evidence: DSL transitions are limited to [*]->increase and the four NL-specified guarded transitions.
inspect_model_to_json_summary reports n_transitions_forced=0 and no events.
findings.summary: No unsafe recovery or hidden fail-open behavior is present. The model contains only the specified normal transitions and no diagnostic or recovery branches.

evidence: Diagnostics include W_DURING_CONST_ASSIGN for k1, k2, n in each state and W_UNREFERENCED_VAR for output variables.
NL requires each state to set concrete valve and pump outputs; those outputs are not required to affect transition guards.
findings.summary: No unjustified warning-driven repair is observed. Constant during assignments and unreferenced output variables are consistent with state-output semantics for valve/pump commands.

evidence: All required states, output actions, and threshold guards in the GroundingMap are present in the DSL.
design_diagnostics_summary ok=true with blocking_count=0.
sim_summary ok=true with 8/8 scenarios passed, covering upper/lower threshold boundary behavior and each specified transition.
findings.summary: Estimated NFRR tier: T3 strong reviewed candidate. The model is compact but not an empty shell; it has high coverage of required discrete FSM structure and behavior. No T0/T1 quality cap is warranted.
